description: This file defines models and functions for handling employee expense sheets and expense lines in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including creation, copying, state transitions, and invoice generation.

classes.name: hr.expense.expense
classes.description: Model for employee expense sheets, including fields, defaults, and methods for state transitions and invoice creation.

classes.name: product.product
classes.description: Extension of product.product to add a boolean field indicating if the product can be expensed.

classes.name: hr.expense.line
classes.description: Model for expense lines, including fields, defaults, and onchange method for product selection.

methods.name: _employee_get
methods.description: Retrieves the employee ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of an expense record with certain fields reset.

methods.name: _amount
methods.description: Calculates total amount for expenses or expense lines.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Determines the default currency based on user's company or default rate.

methods.name: expense_confirm
methods.description: Transitions expense state to 'confirm' and sets confirmation date.

methods.name: expense_accept
methods.description: Transitions expense state to 'accepted' and sets validation date and user.

methods.name: expense_canceled
methods.description: Cancels the expense, setting state to 'cancelled'.

methods.name: expense_paid
methods.description: Marks the expense as paid, setting state to 'paid'.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates an invoice from the expense, including invoice lines and related data.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Updates expense line fields based on selected product.
